mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: GDP level below 20,000 billion 2017 dollars (GDPC1 < 20000) signals weak economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 20000.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals an inflationary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1500 thousand units (HOUST < 1500) signals housing market slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500.
